status: Prospective analysis specification for previously examined archives; exploratory, not held-out confirmation.
hypothesis: Past native memory features can predict joint removal utility across sequences; predicted-region occupancy adds value beyond features and a dimension-matched geometry control.
unit: One target by joint arm across all older memory frames and all four attention layers. Never assign a group effect to individual tokens or count layers as independent.
cohort: 21 sequences, seq2 through seq23 excluding seq7; seq1 excluded. Four fixed GT-present targets per sequence; 84 targets x 3 equal-budget arms = 252 rows. Validate but exclude 90 GT-empty arm rows. No claim about absent-frame safety.
outcome: Dice_native - Dice_after_removal; positive means harmful removal. All three arms remove 256 tokens per older memory frame/layer. Exclude half-budget A/B.
features: Per layer, pool removed past memory vectors: mean64, std64, elementwise product of mean with latest past memory mean64, mean/std age, mean cached first-read mass, mean norm, x/y mean/std =200. Shared descriptors: native first-pass object-score logit, native first-pass mean sigmoid low-res probability, count older frames. No treatment outputs, GT descriptors, sequence/frame/arm identity, or current post-decoding memory vectors.
regional: Append per-layer mean/std and 64 vector covariances for soft stored-mask occupancy and within-cell mixture (4 times variance of sigmoid native mask values in each 4x4 footprint). No hard region classes or new prediction gate. Uses model prediction, not anatomy.
geometry_control: Same 132 extra dimensions per layer, using x/y position fields rather than occupancy/mixture. Generic native memory features remain mask-conditioned by SAM2.
estimator: Reuse installed upstream scikit-learn StandardScaler + Ridge(cholesky), both weighted so each training sequence has equal total weight. Pipeline preprocessing fitted inside every training split. Unbounded signed utility output.
outer: LeaveOneGroupOut over sequence; all arms/targets of held sequence excluded from training and alpha selection. Patient independence unverified.
selection: GroupKFold equal-sequence validation MSE; exact ties choose larger alpha. All modes use same search.
primary: Equal-sequence OOF MSE; compare regional against features and geometry. Also zero utility and training-sequence mean baselines.
secondary: Within-target three-arm pair concordance, true ties omitted and prediction ties score 0.5. Offline choose lowest predicted utility; average exact prediction ties. Report choice vs native and vs uniform mixture of the three arms, plus oracle best-of-three headroom. These are retrospective sampled immediate effects, not full propagation.
continuation: All required: regional MSE lower than zero and train-mean; MSE reduction bootstrap lower>0 and >=14/21 wins vs BOTH features and geometry; pair concordance>0.5 and both controls; offline choice-vs-uniform bootstrap lower>0 and mean choice-minus-native>0. These are research continuation criteria, never model confidence gates.
statistics: Sequence bootstrap 10000, paired Wilcoxon/Holm for the two MSE contrasts. Descriptive uncertainty on OOF errors: folds overlap and bootstrap does not refit nested CV. No independent generalization claim.
failure_action: Stop before attention-module implementation or inference. Do not change features, regularization grid or cohort because outcomes disappoint. Report a negative result as limited to this linear probe and sampled joint interventions.
archive_checks: Pin completion/audit receipts; verify checkpoint/manifest/prompt, full native target-logit hashes, all block/retained-index hashes, four layers/causality/pointers/budgets, bank hashes, group occupancy/norm, prediction PNG and GT hashes and recomputed Dice. Run171 lacks full vector elementwise hashes: disclose this lineage limitation.
sources: Existing Run166 archive extraction and project sequence statistics; Run171 measured interventions. This is a project diagnostic, not an author-provided segmentation method.
output: Only Google Drive outputs/experiment/173_token_utility_probe_v1/attempt_NN. Preserve old archives. Snapshot protocol, code and sklearn source files; record progress, folds, predictions, completion/failure.
